title: Asian and Pacific Islander students make up 1.6% of Walnut Street Elementary enrollment for 2025-26
text:
Walnut Street Elementary School enrolled eight Asian and Pacific Islander students for the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 60% increase from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
In total, July school attendance figures indicated Walnut Street Elementary had 510 students for 2025-26. Of these, Asian and Pacific Islander students accounted for 1.6% of total enrollment, ranking as the school’s third most common ethnicity.
Located in the Uniondale Union Free School District, the school’s central office is in Uniondale.
Out of eight schools within the district, Uniondale High School reported the highest number of Asian and Pacific Islander students, enrolling 24 at that point in time.
World Population Review’s analysis found New York’s public education system ranked second in the nation overall , yet it stood 31st in K-12 performance.
